commands.name: check
commands.run: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run format:check && bun run lint

commands.name: build
commands.run: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build && bun run typecheck

setup.name: bun
setup.command: command -v bun >/dev/null && [ "$(bun --version)" = 1.3.11 ] || { curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash -s bun-v1.3.11 && sudo ln -sf $HOME/.bun/bin/bun /usr/local/bin/bun && sudo ln -sf $HOME/.bun/bin/bun /usr/local/bin/bunx; }

setup.name: node
setup.command: command -v node >/dev/null || { curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_24.x | sudo -E bash - && sudo apt-get install -y nodejs; }
